# SC-05: Every product code is in the LC-nnnn form after the clean-up

## Steps
1. Pick 40 rows of the order sheet copy and 20 items in the QuickBooks Online sandbox.
2. Check each product code's form.

## Expected result
All 60 sampled codes are in the LC-nnnn form (60 cases).
